column8: ∀ (fields : List (String × Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data)) (fuel : ℕ) (rest : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendCheckpoint.Tokens), List.length (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.encodeDataFields fields) ≤ fuel → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.decodeDataFields fuel (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.encodeDataFields fields ++ rest) = Option.some (fields, rest)

∀ (data : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (fuel : ℕ) (rest : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendCheckpoint.Tokens), List.length (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.encodeData data) ≤ fuel → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.decodeData fuel (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.encodeData data ++ rest) = Option.some (data, rest)

∀ {α : Type} {frame : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes} {stream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec α} {bytes : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes} {value : α}, (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.framed frame stream).decode bytes = Option.some value → (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.framed frame stream).encode value = bytes

∀ {α : Type} (frame : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes) (stream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec α) (value : α), (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.framed frame stream).decode ((Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.framed frame stream).encode value) = Option.some value

∀ (rootBytes : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (transaction : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) (posts : List Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Post) (guards : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReadGuard) (nullifiers : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier) (sealing : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Seal), (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.intentOf rootBytes transaction posts guards nullifiers sealing).nullifiers = nullifiers ++ sealing.nullifiers

∀ (rootBytes : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (transaction : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) (posts : List Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Post) (guards : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReadGuard) (nullifiers : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier) (sealing : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Seal), (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.intentOf rootBytes transaction posts guards nullifiers sealing).transactionId = transaction

∀ (rootBytes : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (transaction : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) (posts : List Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Post) (guards : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReadGuard) (nullifiers : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier) (sealing : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Seal), (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.intentOf rootBytes transaction posts guards nullifiers sealing).writes = List.map (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Post.write rootBytes) posts
